reviews.text: I cant thank the lovely staff enough especially Alice the lovely vet that helped our Toffee with her leg , she was truly amazing ❤️

Recently our Cavapoo dog, George, became very unwell. The care and support we received from the test especially Alice (vet) far exceeded our expectations. Alice made us feel listened to, understood and valued during this very stressful and emotive time. We felt that Alice went above and beyond as she maintained regular contact with us not only on appointments but also phoning in between to check on George which made us feel very supported and reassured. She made us feel that she really cared for George as well as us giving time to play with him to help reduce his anxiety.
A massive thank you to Alice and all her team.

Lovely visit to Leeds Vets4Pets this morning for my cats' annual vaccinations. As usual, the reception staff were friendly and welcoming and Alice went above and beyond, giving the cats their jabs but also discussing one of my cat's ongoing health issues. I've been a customer for 9 years and have nothing but positive things to say. I know my cats are in good hands.

They are racist or something as other people have gone in a got help.
Lady in front of me was white and just sadi I will pay later and they where fine with that. When it came to me they were not willing to help at all.
It's weird how they only show 5 star reviews. This is, because vet4pets has them removed so the truth of the practice does not come out.
For a tablets that cost 11p they where changing me 1.80 per tablet,along a mark up of 1.69
Other uid I needed is available for 26  for 5 months supply online and they where charging me 50 for one months supply.
The real reason I am banded is because I dared to tell them that I could get meds for cheaper and they could have told me this before I spent hundreds of pounds and struggling to eat.
So please don't use this vets if you Value your pets life.
They are horrible and if you dare to bring up any problem. They will lecture you about it. The reception has done this when I complained about the prices of medication and last time I was left hanging for four days and was ignored and then only repoonded to when I left a review about them after they refused to help and then they said we will give a free scan if you take down the review which i did for my cats sake. Now I have complained about prices and had a lecture of the receptionist I have received a letter to say they will no longer provide care. FROM EXPERIENCE PLEASE DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY OR PRACTICE THEY ONLY CARE ABOUT MONEY AND IF YOU COMPLAIN THEY WILL TELL YOU YOUR TONE IS, OFF. THIS IS THE WORST VETS YET. HORRIBLE ABOUSULTY WILL LET YOU PET DIED FOR MONEY. IF I HAVE THE LETTER AS PROOF AND WE CAN TAKE IT FURTHER IF YOU WISH.
Oh and if you tell them you are struggling they will be sure to push kalrna on you or just refuse to help. This has been my experience with vet4pets on eastley road.

Very rude when they called me for permission to transfer care to a better vet.
Very very rude tone used. They act very superior.forgetting she is just a receptionist at a vets. Disgusting really.

The people at this vets are amazing so helpful and caring I recently had my Male cat Jimmy castrated and theymessaged me the next day to make sure he was ok and taking his medication would highly recommend this vet

Avoid this place worst vets in Leeds unprofessional staff and over charge for services.

Side note receptionist the older one is very rude when they cannot get their way.

And I find the casual offering to spade a animal (mutilate) disgusting.

Vets for Pets Easterly Road has been my vets since getting my boy Conker 2 and a half years ago. He’s had a myriad of reactivity and health issues and the vets have always been amazing at not stopping until we’ve figured out what’s causing his symptoms and how to get him feeling better! The vets and reception staff are all so friendly and professional and always have the time to make you feel comfortable and well informed about the care your pet is receiving. Alice and Simon have been particularly helpful on the journey to Conker being well and I can’t thank them enough. I’m not sure what I would have done without them! Highly recommend this surgery!
Thank you for your 5-star review! We really appreciate your support and are delighted you had a positive experience with our team.
Thank you for rating us 5 star

We're sorry to see you felt our service wasn't up to our usual standard. It would be useful to know how we can improve for the future. If you can let us know how we fell short, by emailing leeds@vetsforpets.com We do take all feedback seriously; good or bad. Thank you for taking the time to review.

Genuinely cannot thank all of the staff here💚 You are all so welcoming and kind, I have never felt silly asking questions. I don’t know everyone’s names but I have spoken with Jackie, Emily, Dan, Alice & Simon on a few occasions, and every single person has been so supportive and helpful with our two buns🐰 Thank you for all of your advice and looking after Bam & Betty. Incredible team - genuinely !!
Thank you for the 5 stars!!!
Thank you for taking the time to respond to our request for feedback. It would be useful to know how we could improve your experIence, for your next visit
So lovely to see you have rated us 5 star. thank you very much.

The very best vets any pet owner could wish for every member of the team are kind and compassionate. I would highly recommend Simon, Alice & Lauren to anyone looking for a super professional team to look after and give advise that is always a pet centric approach!
Thank you so much for awarding us 5 stars!!!!!

Vets 4 Pets Easterly Road has to be the best vets around. The staff are all amazing and in the two years I’ve been a client have been wonderful treating my diabetic dog, nothing is ever too much trouble and the reception staff all so helpful.  I can’t speak highly enough of the Vets  especially Simon and Laura who have given  Amber five star care on every visit.
I have been going there for years with pet past a d present, always found them friendly and professional

I cant thanks vets for pets on easterly rd leeds enough.. i had a appointment for my very ill old fur baby bella today.. my car broken down i called to tell them i couldn't get a taxi that would take bella and i would walk id be 30 mins late .. one of the lovely ladies only came and picked us up so we wouldn't miss are appointment ❤️. All the staff have been so helpful. Kind and so caring for bella and me.. and this was only are 2nd visit.. never meet such lovely people thanks so much for everything ❤️ 5 stars just isnt enough...

We are grateful to Emily the vet, today at 6 pm, for being so kind, helpful, friendly and professional. Emily made our cat Cleo feel very comfortable and gave us lots of great advice. Thank you Emily! ☺️🐈 …

This has been my boys' vets since moving to Leeds and I am always happy with the care and attention to detail. They ensure I'm kept updated and my cat has become familiar with the vets and doesn't freak out anywhere near as much as he used to!

A massive thank you to everyone at Vets for Pets Leeds! I have never dealt with vets before as I am a first time pet owner, and I cannot thank all of the staff enough for being so helpful! They answer all of my questions and look after my two little bunnies so well🐰 I’m so grateful for their support, from entering the vets to leaving, every single member of staff is so friendly💚
Want to thank Alice and jackie here for looking after molly showing so much compassion , which helped us so much after loosing her thank you again and for everything you have done for molly ❤️
This practise is wonderful the staff are very proffessional and caring its the best vets I have ever used

on a trip to Sheffield I had stopped in Leeds to let my dog out in a quiet and nice looking park. within 10 mins he was attacked by an off-lead pitbull who came out of nowhere. I rushed him to the nearest open vets and these guys looked after him immediately. can't thank them enough for how fast they acted and sorted us out.
Thank you for the 4 star rating. We are looking forward to seeing you back next week.
5 stars amazing. thank you so much
Thank you very much for rating us. 5 stars

I want everyone to know that if your beloved pet is in need then this is the place to bring them, Simon is the best vet I have ever been to and this is talking from being a doggie owner for over 20 years having visited vets all over the UK. Simon being faced with a very difficult case never gave up on Teddy he gave him his all and tried new medical procedures and thank the lord he did, Teddy went from the brink of death to three months later very nearly being back to normal. I would like to thank everyone who had been involved with teddys care you are all amazing, there has been many dark days over the last three months and I don’t think she knows it but Jackie has been keeping me going she takes the time to talk to me and has a lovely warm nature, caring and sweet. Thank you for being there for Teddy and myself we couldn’t have done this without you ❤️
Thank you for the 5 stars. It really means the world us.
So far so good 👍 …
Vets ok meds expensive
How much cost for sterilised cat year check up? He was sterilised last year in December?
Friendly staff and very caring.

Been using this vets for the last 10 years for my cat Tenka. Being an outdoor cat he often gets into fights and he's been through the wars recently (literally). They are beyond thorough as Tenka was taken in for a tooth clean but under further investigation they have found a large lump. We are incredibly grateful to Laura and the rest of the team!!!

Our loved labrador cassie went over the rainbow 🌈  bridge and the staff and vets were so understanding and caring for her we can't thank them enough ,they even came out to the car to see her so we didn't have to put her thru too much stress ,and this morning  we had a lovely and thoughtful card from them they went above and beyond  thank you so much , from all of Cassie's family x

I couldn’t recommend this vets enough. My fur baby Simba unfortunately had to have emergency surgery for his eye. Everyone here was amazing from the receptionist I can’t remember her name to the vet Alice who took care of him. They really do have the biggest hearts ❤️a big thank you to them all
Took injured pigeon here, which involved physically handling it - left without washing my hands.
A few weeks ago, we lost our as our boy zapper and I can’t find the vet enough for what they did for their compassion and loyalty throughout a big thank you to the vets

Staff great and nurse my dog saw was super with my dog, she genuinely loves animals, it shows.
There again today, this time to see the vet, again my dog can't wait to get in, barks to let them know she's there and rushes in to the room as soon as the door opens for her. Glad she's like that as she has to go every month. They're so good with her. Can't recommend them enough.

Friendly vets.
Really listens to you concerns.

We have two dogs, a husky named Mowgli and a German shepherd named Max 🙂 and their uncle Danny works at vets4pets and we just love visiting. Every staff member is warm and welcoming and always puts both our rescue dogs at ease. I’m bias because Danny is my big brother - he is so knowledgable and always there to answer any questions we have. I’m so proud to call him my big brother even if he does paint warhammer in his spare time. Anyway - back to my review, thank you Leeds vets4pets, and thank you to my big brother, we wouldn’t want to take our boys anywhere else and we would recommend this vets to everyone. Love Lucy (the best younger sister  ever) x
Absolutely love the staff here and so do my 2 dogs my big boy make a bee line for Jackie on reception and she always makes a big fuss over them both

Took my 3 week old kitten to them recommended by pdsa. All went well at first untill the vet brought a young lady in who stood watching while I was taking to the vet the kitten walked to the edge of the table and fell off. The girl did nothing to stop or pick him up leaving it me to do that. The vet fobbed it off. I put a complaint in on line. Received a call from the vets an apology. Was told she was work experience and first day. But she didn't use any common sense.
Sorry this is not acceptable the kitten was a rescue found on a street.

These guys are lovely, they make me and my puppy feel so welcome and my last dog actually looked forward to coming here!
I do like the paid monthly plan that they offer too. Definitely recommend

I don’t think 5*’s are quite enough for these amazing humans. We’ve been coming to these guys for the last 3 years & they always go above & beyond for our 2 girls. We’ve had numerous surgeries performed & each time, they’ve always shown great love, care & compassion.
We honestly couldn’t have picked a better team of people to care for our girls, especially during the most difficult times.
They truly are such beautiful souls.
Betty & Lola H’s Mum x

I booked a neutering appointment with it being my second one, I previously missed the first one due to some circumstances and at the time I did not call to opt out which I acknowledge is my mistake and I could’ve tried to find the time to do that. I arrived for my second appointment at 8:13 being late 13 minutes which again I take full responsibility for being late, but when I talked to the receptionist and she asked if I was the 8:00, I said yes then while looking at her computer in very condescending way said “Late” I said I was sorry and I hope 13 minutes isn’t too much  but mid sentence she again interrupted me saying “Late”, after that she tried to see if she can fit my in but that isn’t a guarantee. I personally would’ve been completely fine with her saying that I was too late and had to rebook but at least in a nice way. I did manage to get the neutering done that day and the vets themselves were amazing.

Amazing service  , friendly and just a pleasure to community and visit given that I had previously had my pet registered with another Leeds Vets 4 Pets practice . If you want to feel valued and your pet adored and  to be treated with respect then this is this practice to go to . Thank you for making us part of the Vets 4 Pets family and keep up the good work .

I really like this vets even though I don't have a cat or dog (but I go with my Bessie mate and her dog if she needs me to go for support for her and her cute little dog)

Always such lovely staff, the best team to look after my boy Oslo!!!! Couldn’t recommend highly enough!
Highly professional and friendly staff, I'd recommend them.

... Rang first thing this morning to cancel my appointment on Friday 28th 5.50pm..received a reminder at 1.0clock about the appointment i had cancelled. Phoned to make sure it was cancelled and was told my appointment was today it most definitely was not because I have a text message proving it., she was a bit rude to be honest!.. I will save my text with the appointment verify ing it too.

Unfortunately we had to put our baby Bella of 17yrs to sleep a week ago very sad. I must say the empathy that was shown to us by certain staff was incredible, when we went in that dreadful day we was shown straight to another room and Alison the lovely vet came in and explained everything and she went at our pace giving us time. Alison first give Bella a sedative which allowed Bella not to be frightened and she was very relaxed and went to sleep, again Alison give us more time. When she came in to give Bella her final injection Bella within seconds was at peace and Alison checked her heartbeat she was gone. Again Alison give us time. A week later we got Bella’s ashes back with some paw prints of her and a lovely card from the staff which we was touched by. We miss our baby very much and the house is quiet without her but we are grateful to the vet Alison, thank you xxx
It was the first time for our kitten Lavender and she was seen by Alice who was lovely. Highly recommended!
Reception staff, vets and nurses alike are very caring and understanding. They show incredible patience with our grumpy old dog and you don't feel rushed in your appointment. …
Fantastic service from all reception staff and vets. Staff have always tried to get a timely appointment for our dog when needed. Feels like a local independent vets despite being a chain, thank you!
The staff are all so very friendly
Very good
Thank you for leaving 5 stars
